{{SameName|Present|[[Present (Village of Despair)|Village of Despair]] • '''Cold Ambush''' • [[Present (Krampus Frosthold)|Krampus Frosthold]]}} {{EventEnded|date = 4th of February 2023|event = [[Violent Night Event]]}} {{Zombie |title1 = Present |image1 = Present1.png |mode_appearance = [[Violent Night Event|Violent Night]] |first_wave_appearance = ???/❄️ |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]20 |shield_hp = [[File:ShieldHealth.png|20px|Shield Health]]20 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Above Average (4) |spawned_by = [[Present2 (Cold Ambush)|Present2]] |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Present''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Cold Ambush]] as part of the [[Violent Night Event]]. It first naturally spawned on Wave ???/❄️, but it could appear earlier as it was spawned by the [[Present2 (Cold Ambush)|Present2]] upon death. It had a low amount of health and an above average speed. Unlike its parent enemies, it did not spawn anything upon death. ==Appearance== The '''Present''' was a humanoid present. The wrapping paper was a pattern of red stars against a blue background. A white ribbon was wrapped across its head and torso, and was tied together with a big red bow on its chest. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers, such as the [[Ranger]], [[Accelerator]], [[Golden Minigunner]] or [[Engineer]] are recommended against this. *The [[Commander]] can be quite useful at decreasing the firerate of these towers. **The [[DJ Booth]] can also be helpful by increasing the range of your towers and decreasing the upgrade costs of them. *The [[Present3 (Cold Ambush)|Present3]] and [[Present2 (Cold Ambush)|Present2]] will create a large amount of '''Presents'''. Because of this, towers like the [[Executioner]] or [[Engineer]] are recommended against this. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} PresentWalk.gif|Walking animation (21 December 2022 – 4 February 2023) }} ==Trivia== *The '''Present''' was very similar to the breaker enemies, specifically the [[Breaker]]. *Due to the [[Present2 (Cold Ambush)|Present2]], the '''Present''' could spawn before its debut wave. ==Update History== *'''21 December 2022''' - [[v1.6.0]] **'''Present''' added. *'''4 February 2023''' - [[v1.6.1]] **'''Present''' removed. {{ColdAmbush2|[[Papa Bread (Cold Ambush)|Papa Bread]]
